visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot focuses on an orange cat with bright green eyes. The cat's mouth is slightly open, revealing small teeth. A yellow text overlay appears at the bottom of the frame against a blurry background featuring household items. (2) A person's hand enters from the right, holding a plush yellow toy shaped like a cat inside a red French fry container. The orange cat sniffs the toy. The scene cuts to the cat lying on a light-colored carpet, holding the toy with its front paws and biting it while rolling its body. (3) The hand presents a plush toy shaped like a cat burger with green lettuce and a red hat. The orange cat sniffs and then bites the burger toy on the floor. In the background, a blue and grey cat tunnel is visible. (4) A tabby cat is shown lying on a light carpet, interacting with a plush toy designed to look like popcorn. The cat rubs its cheeks against the soft texture of the toy and then transitions into kicking it with its hind legs while holding it firmly with its front paws. (5) A white tray holding a variety of fast-food-themed plush toys is displayed against a yellow background. The shot sequence follows with a hand holding a pizza-slice plushie, an ice cream cone plushie with a pink scoop, and finally a black cat plushie in a red soda cup shown next to a real black cat sitting in a cardboard box. (6) A promotional layout is shown on a solid yellow background. All the previous fast-food plush toys are arranged neatly on a white tray. Bold text overlays in Chinese and a website URL appear at the bottom of the frame. (7) A tabby cat is seen hugging a long, yellow and white cat-shaped pillow. The scene then shifts to a man with short black hair wearing a white t-shirt and blue shorts lying on a bed. He is energetically hugging the same large pillow, rolling around with a joyful expression on his face. (8) The final sequence shows a tabby cat standing on top of two large cat-shaped pillows on a wooden floor. The cat performs a rhythmic treading or kneading motion with its paws on the pillows. A brown leather sofa is partially visible in the background under warm indoor lighting.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Product Feature Showcase -> User Variation -> Call to Action -> Comedic Twist.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a commercial promotion for a series of 'fast-food' themed catnip toys and human-sized plush pillows. It aims to drive sales by showcasing the cute and engaging interactions of cats with the products, followed by a relatable human demonstration of the large-scale merchandise.
